hymns.title: ABỤ M ACHICHA DỊ NDỤ

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Kristi ekwugo ya wee sị: Beeresọ m' i riri ahụ n'ọbara Nwa nke mmadụ, ñụkwaa ọbara ya; Beeresọ m'i riri ya, nwanne m, M' i riri ahụ mụ o; Beeresọ m'i ñụrụ ọbara mụ o, Ọbara dị oke ọnụ, Ị gaghi enwe ndụ n' ime gị.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Abụ m achịcha dị ndụ Na-enye ndụ ebighebi; Kristi bụ achịcha dị ndụ Nna nyere anyị. Bịanụ nara Kristi, Onye nwụrụ maka anyị; Bịanụ naranụ Kristi, Onye zọpụtara anyị.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Abụ m achịcha dị ndụ (ref.) Ndị otu Kristi, Kristi ekwugo: Naranụ m rie, Naranụ m ñụọ, Nri na-enye ndụ, Nri si n' igwe, Achịcha dị nsọ, Rie nweta ndụ ebighebi. (ref.)

hymns.refrain: Abụ m achịcha dị ndụ, Dinwenụ na-ekwu, Abụ m achịcha dị ndụ Nke si n' eluigwe bịa. Abụ m achịcha dị ndụ, Nri na-enye ndụ, n'ezie, Abụ m achịcha dị ndụ Nke si n' eluigwe bịa; $ Onye riri ahụ mụ o Onye ñụrụ ọbara mụ o Ga-adị ndụ n'ezie D$ ọkpụ. (2nd time)

hymns.title: ACHICHA DỊ NDỤ SI N' ELUIGWE

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Onye riri achịcha nke a, Ga-enwe ndụ ọkpụ.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Achịcha m ga-enye ụnụ bụ ahụ m Maka ndụ nke ụnụ.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Onye riri ahụ m, ñụọ ọbara m, Ga-ebi n' ime m.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Onye riri ahụ m, ñụọ ọbara m, Aga m ebi n' ime ya.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Ahụ m bụ ihe oriri ezie, Ọbara m bụ ihe ọñụñụ ezie

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: Onye riri, ñụọ m na-etoghị eto, Mara onwe ya ikpe ọnwụ.

verses.label: VERSE 7
verses.text: Oge ụnụ na-eme ihe ndị a, Ụnụ na-echeta ọnwụ m.

verses.label: VERSE 8
verses.text: Ezigbo Jesu ji ahụ ya azụ m; Ekele dịrị gị.

verses.label: VERSE 9
verses.text: Etosighị m k'ị bata n'ime m, Maka njọ m mere.

verses.label: VERSE 10
verses.text: Were ọbara gị dị oke ọnụ, Wụchapụ njọ m mere.

hymns.refrain: Abụ m achịcha dị ndụ, Abụ m achịcha dị ndụ, Si n'eluigwe bịa.

hymns.title: AGA M ANATA JESU

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Ọ na-asọ m ka m nata Jesu n'obi m. Dinwenụ, bia bata n' ime obi m, Nonyere m oge niile m nọ n'ụwa. Dinwenụ, bata n'obi m.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Aka nke ịhụnanya gị na-echedo m, Okwu nke ndụ nke ị gwara m n'oziọma, Biko gbaghara m mmehie m niile, Ka m wee tosị ịnata gị.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: N'oriri nsọ nke ụbọchị taata, Jesu Kristi, nye anyị grasịa nke gị, K'anyị wee tosị ịba n'alaeze gị, Dinwenụ, bata n'obi m.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Biko chebe mkpụrụobi m mgbe dum, Ka ekwensu ghara inwe ike n' ebe m nọ. Amarala m na ị ga-edobe m N'ime obi gị, ebeebe.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Otito dịrị Nna na Nwa, Ya na Mmụọ Nsọ, ha atọ bụ otu Chukwu, Otu ọ dịrị na mbụ, ga na-adị Otu ahụ ruo ebeebe.

hymns.refrain: Aga m anata Jesu, iko bata n' ime obi m, gwu adịghị m mgbe bula ị nọ n'obi m. ga-eduba m n'alaeze gị. D.$.

hymns.title: AGA M EJI GINI KELEE OLISA

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Aga m eji gini kelee gị o? (kelee gị o) Aga m eji gini kelee gị? Oseburụwa Chukwu, Onye mere ihe niile dị n' ụwa, chọọ ha mma, Were ha nye anyị, Sị anyị ñụrịwa na ha.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Aga m ejidi akụ n'ụba kelee gị o, (Chineke) Aga m ejidi ihe oriri kelee gị o? Aga m ejidi akụ n' ụba kelee gị o? Ọ bụdị nke kọrọ gị? Ọ bụdị nke kọrọ gị? Ọ bụdị nke kọrọ gị (Chineke)? Chineke, Ọkaka, Onye ebube.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Keleenụ ya, keleenụ ya; Afọọma ya karịrị akari, Afọọma ya karịrị igụta ọnụ, Kelee ya, Onye ọma.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Chineke doo, (Ekele dịrị Chineke), Chineke doo, (Chineke, Odogwu, Onyenwe m), Aga m eji gini kelee gị o? Chineke, Ọkaka. N' ihe i meere anyị, (Ref) I zitere Nwa gị, Chineke: (Ref) Ka ọ gbapụta anyị na njọ: (Ref) Megheere anyị ụzọ nke igwe: (Ref)

hymns.refrain: Aga m eji gini kelee Olisa? Aga m eji gini kelee Nna mụ o? Aga m eji gini kelee Chineke, Onye bi n'igwe, onye obioma, Oseburụwa Chukwu, Chukwu, Ọkaka.

hymns.title: AHỤ KRISTI

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Ahụ Kristi mụ o, Bụ nri nke m ga-eri, Ọbara onye nzọpụta, Nye m ndụ ebeebe.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Ahụ Kristi mụ o, Bụkwa ndụ nke mụ o, Ahụ onye nzọpụta mụ o Amen, Amen.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Ahụ Kristi bụ Ihe oriri, Ọbara ya bụkwa Ihe ọñụñụ.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: O Jesu nke mụ o, Biko, nye m ahụ gị. Nyekwa m ọbara gị Ka m rie, ka m ñụọ.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Biko Jesu, doo, Chineke nke mụ o, Were ọsọ zute mụ o, Ezigbo Chukwu.

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: Chukwu eze mụ o, Onye nwe ndụ mụ o, Sọ gị ka m na-akpọku, Ezi Chukwu.

verses.label: VERSE 7
verses.text: O Jesu nke mụ o, i si n'igwe bịa, Maka ihi ndị ọme njọ, Ewoo, ewoo.

hymns.refrain: Ahụ, ahụ, ahụ Kristi, Ọbara Kristi, Amen. Amen.

hymns.title: AHỤ KRISTI BỤ SỌ MMA

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Ọ bụ sọ ndị na-ebughị njọ n'obi Bụ ndị nwere ike inata ya N'obi añụrị.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Ndị niile natara Jesu n'obi, Ma ha bụkwa njọ ogbugbu n'obi, Dakwara iwu.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Onye natara Jesu n'obi dị mma Ga-enwe añụrị ebighebi N'ụwa ọzọ.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Onye natara Jesu ga-adị umeala, Ọ ga-adị ọcha pụrụ iche N' ime obi ya.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Ekworo, anya ukwu na ọbọ, Nna wepụ N' obi ndị niile natara Jesu Kristi. K' anyị zere iwu niile Nna tiiri, Na iwu niile nke Nzukọ Na nke obodo. Makana iwu niile si n'eluigwe bịa, Ma nke Nzukọ, ma nke obodo Tiiri anyị.

hymns.refrain: Ahụ Kristi bụ sọ mma, Bịakwute m. Ọbara Kristi k'e ji Gbapụta ụwa. D.C.

hymns.title: AHỤ NA ỌBARA KRISTI

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Jesu (Kristi) ọkpara Chineke, Nwa Chineke, Onye nwụrụ ọnwụ n'elu obe maka ihi anyị, O kwesịrị ekwesị inye ya nsọpụrụ, (Na ndụ gị niile cheta) Kristi kwesịrị nsọpụrụ; Nye ya nsọpụrụ n' ihe ọbụla ị na-eme, (N'oge ọbụla na ndụ gị).

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Tupu ị ga-eje ka ị nata ya, Nyochaa onwe gị, nyochaa onwe gị, Nyochaa onwe gị, (omume gị), Nyochaa onwe gị, Nyochaa akọ n' uche gị o Nyochaa onwe gị, nyochaa onwe gị; (N' ihina ọ sị) Onye ọbụla natara m Na-adịghị nkwadebe, (onye ahụ) Riteere onwe ya amamikpe ebighebi; (Biko nwanne m), kwadoo onwe gị Tupu ị jee nara ya, doo.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Bịa nara m rie, (Kristi na-akpọ), Bịa nara m ñụọ, (ọ sịrị). Onye riri ahụ m, ma ñụọ ọbara mụ o, (Onye ahụ) ga-ebi n' ime m. Mụ ebirikwa n' ime ya; Abụ m ụzọ, ndụ, na eziokwu; Onye riri ahụ m, ma ñụọ ọbara m, (Onye ahụ) ga-enwe ndụ ebighebi; (Dinwenụ na-ekwu).

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: (Nna dị ebube, biko,) 3x Nna dị ebube, biko, Site n' ahụ n' ọbara nwa gị, Nke ị ji azụ anyị nri, (nri ndụ ebighebi) Sachapụ ọ mmehie anyị; Kpọghachi anyị azụ n' ebe ị nọ, Ka ọ ga-abụ n' ọge ikpeazụ, K' anyị sorọ na ndị ga-añụrị ọñụ N'alaeze gị, n'alaeze gị, n' alaeze eluigwe. Nara ekpere anyị, nara ekpere anyị, Nara ekpere anyị, nara ekpere anyị kpere N'aha Jesu Kristi, ọkpara gị, Nara, n' aha Jesu Kristi, Onyenweanyị. (Doo nara) N' aha Jesu Kristi, Onyenweanyị. Nna, biko nara ya, nara Nna, Nara, nara, biko Nna mụ o, Nara ekpere anyị, biko, Nara, nara, nara ya, Nara, nara, nara ya, Nara ekpere, nara ekpere, Nara ekpere anyị, ezi Nna, Nara o. Amen! Amen! Amen!

hymns.refrain: Onyenweanyị, Jesu Kristi, Onyenweanyị, Jesu Kristi, Onye dị nsọ, onye dị ebube, kwesị nsọpụrụ, (Onye ọma, onye ukwu, dike n' agha) Ọ bụ ahụ n'ọbara ya k'anyị na-anata Na Sakramenti, Sakramenti, Sakramenti dị nsọ Ọ bụ ahụ n'ọbara ya k'anyị na-anata Na Sakramenti nke Yukarịstịa.

hymns.title: AJA DỊ NSỌ

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Anyị ekele gị maka ọgọ gị niile Chukwu, biko nara aja, Nara ụmụ gị gọzie. Anyị ekele gị maka afọọma gị: (Ref) Anyị ekele gị, Nna, maka ngọzi gị: (Ref)

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Anyị enye gị nsọpụrụ Na otito kacha elu: (Ref) Anyị edoo gị ebube, Nna, Onye kacha elu: (Ref) Anyị ebunye gị iko nsọ, Biko nara ya: (Ref)

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Anyị arịọ gị mgbaghara njọ anyị: (Ref) Anyị arịọ gị ebere n' obodo anyị: (Ref) Anyị arịọ gị grasịa na ngozi niile: (Ref)

hymns.refrain: Aja dị nsọ, Aja dị oke ọnụ, 'K'ụmụ Chineke na-achụrụ Chukwu; Aja anyị na-achụrụ Chukwu Bụ onwe anyị, Ahụ na mkpụrụobi anyị $ Nara Nna, nara, Nara onyinye ụmụ gị, Nara aja dị nsọ. D.$.

hymns.title: AKỤ NA ỤBA CHINEKE NYERE M

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Ka anyị kelee Chineke, maka ihe ọma ya.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Chetakwa na Chineke bụ onye dị ọcha.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Ihe ọbụla ị ga-enye ya bụkwa ihe dị ọcha.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Nke ga-esi n' ezigbo obi gị pụta.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Chineke ga-enye gị otu ọ dị ya mma.

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: Ka ị were si na ya wee kelee Chukwu.

verses.label: VERSE 7
verses.text: Chineke Nna dị ebube chọrọ ihe otito.

verses.label: VERSE 8
verses.text: Nke a ga-eji too ya, too ya mgbe niile.

verses.label: VERSE 9
verses.text: Site taata wee ruo mgbe ebighebi. Amen.

hymns.refrain: Akụ na ụba Chineke nyere m, Aga m eji ya tụọrọ ya mma mma D.C.

hymns.title: AKỤ NA ỤBA M NIILE

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Ị siri n' aja wee kpụọ m, Tinye m ndụ, Ndụ m si n' aka gị, Chukwu.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Ị kere m n' oyiyi gị; Ị nyere m amamihe gị. Akọ na uche na ọgụgụ isi m Bụ onyinye ọma gị, Chukwu.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Ike nke m ji arụ ọrụ ụbọchị m; Mmụọ ịgba mbọ nke ị nyere m; Gịnị ka m ga-akwụghachi N' ihe niile ị na-emere m, Chukwu.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Akụ na ụba m niile, Ego na ihe onwunwe, Mmụta m na aka ọrụ m Si n'aka gị, Onye na-eme mma.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Ị mere m okorobịa, Okorobịa siri ike, Okorobịa na-aga n'ihu; Okorobịa niile Bụ gị mere ha, onye ebube.

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: Ị mere m agbọghọbịa, Agbọghọbịa bụ sọ mma. Nnenwaanyị na nnammadụ Ihe ọbụla onye ọbụla bụ Si n'aka gị onye dị mma.

hymns.refrain: Akụ na ụba m niile si n'aka Chineke, Chukwu onye na-eme mma; Onye na-eme mma, aga m ekele gị, Aga m ekele gị mgbe dum.

hymns.title: A MỤRỤ DINWENỤ N'ỤWA

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Ndị Mmụọọma siri n'eluigwe gbadata n'ụwa, Mgbe a mụrụ Dinwenụ; Ha na-ekwere ya ukwe, Ha na-ekwere ya ukwe na-asị:

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Ụwa niile, soronụ ndị Mmụọọma, Soronụ ndị Mmụọọma, Werenụ ubọ, ubọ dị ụtọ, Ubọ na opi, kwebere ya ukwe na-asị:

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Jesu abịawo, Onye nzọpụta anyị, Jesu abịawo; Kristi abịawo, Onye nzọpụta anyị, Kristi abịawo. Nwebenụ añụri, Nwebenụ añụri na Kristi abịawo. Ọ bịawo n'onwe ya, Jesu abịawonu n' onwe ya. Kwebere ya ukwe na-asị:

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Otito, Otito, Otito dịiri Nna onye zitere gị; Dịiri gị, Kristi eze a mụrụ ọhụrụ. Otito, Otito, Otito dịiri Nna onye zitere gị, Dịiri gị, dịkwaara Mmụọ Nsọ ebeebe. Amen! Amen! Amen!

hymns.refrain: Aleluya! Aleluya! Hozana! Hozana! N' ebe kacha elu dịiri gị, Jesu Kristi. Aleluya! Aleluya! Hozana! Hozana! N' ebe kacha elu dịiri nwa Chukwu: Jesu Kristi.

hymns.title: A MỤRỤ NWA KA NWA

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: A mụrụ nwa ka nwa o, Nwa Chineke onye kacha elu; A mụrụ Onyenweanyị o, Nwa Chineke onye kacha elu; Onye nzọpụta e kwere anyị na nkwa na mbụ, Aleluya! ọ bịawo. D.$1

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: (Bianụ ka anyị jee, Bianụ ka anyị jee) Ngwanụ ka anyị jee Betlehem, Jee hụrụ nwa ka nwa. (Bianụ ka anyị jee, bianụ ka anyị jee) Ngwanụ ka anyị jee Betlehem, Jee hụrụ Onyenweanyị, Nwa Chineke onye kacha elu. Onye nzọpụta e kwere anyị na nkwa na mbụ, Aleluya! ọ bịawo.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Ndị ncheatụrụ agaalarị jee hụ, Mgbe ndị Mmụọozi gwara ha Na a mụrụ nwa ka nwa. Ndị eze atọ agaalarị jee hụ, (Ihe ebube nke mere). Mgbe kpakpando ziri ha Ebe a mụrụ Onyenweanyị. D.$2 Ndị ncheatụrụ gara sekpuoro ya ka nwa; Ndị eze atọ gara sekpuoro ya ka nwa, Nye ya onyinye, (Onyinye ọla edo, Frankinsens na Mea) O' gịnị k'anyị ga-eme? O' gịnị k'anyị ga- enye? (Anyị ga-akpọ isiala nye ya Kwee ukwe ọñụ nye ya Kwekwaara ya ukwe otito sị) Otito dịrị Chineke n' elu kacha elu N' ụwa udo dịrị ndị mmadụ ndị obi ọcha; (makana,) D.$.1

hymns.refrain: Nnukwu ihe mere na Betlehem, Ihe ọñụ mere na Betlehem, N'obodo Devid; Ngwanụ ka anyị jee lee. D.C.

hymns.title: IT IS WELL WITH MY SOUL

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: When peace like a river attendeth my way, When sorrows like sea billows roll; Whatever my lot, thou hast taught me to know, It is well, it is well with my soul.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Though Satan should buffet, Though trials should come, Let this blessed assurance control; That Christ hath regarded my helpless estate, And hath shed his own blood for my soul.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: My sin, oh! The bliss of this glorious thought, My sin, not in part, but the whole Is nailed to his cross, and I bear it no more; Praise the Lord, praise the Lord, Oh! My soul.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: For me be it Christ, be it Christ hence to live, If Jordan above me shall roll; No pang shall be mine, for in death as in life, Thou wilt whisper thy peace to my soul.

hymns.refrain: It is well, (it is well) With my soul, (with my soul) It is well, it is well With my soul.

hymns.title: PASS ME NOT, O GENTLE SAVIOUR

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Pass me not, O gentle Saviour, Hear my humble cry; While on others thou art calling, Do not pass me by.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Let me at a throne of mercy Find a sweet relief; Kneeling there in deep contrition, Help my unbelief.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Trusting only in thy merit, Would I seek thy face; Heal my wounded, broken spirit, Save me by thy grace.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Thou the spring of all my comfort, More than life to me; Whom have I on earth besides thee? Whom in heaven but thee?

hymns.refrain: Saviour, Saviour, hear my humble cry; And while others thou art calling Do not pass me by.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Peace, perfect peace, In this dark world of sin? The blood of Jesus whispers Peace within.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Peace, perfect peace, By thronging duties pressed? To do the will of Jesus, this is rest.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Peace, perfect peace, With sorrows surging round? On Jesus' bosom nought but calm is found.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Peace, perfect peace, With loved ones far away? In Jesus' keeping we are safe, and they.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Peace, perfect peace, Our future all unknown? Jesus we know, and he is on the throne.

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: Peace, perfect peace, death shadowing us and ours? Jesus has vanquished death and all its powers.

verses.label: VERSE 7
verses.text: It is enough; earth's troubles soon shall cease, and Jesus call us to heaven's perfect peace.

hymns.title: THY HAND, O GOD, HAS GUIDED

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Thy hand, O God, has guided Thy flock from age to age; The wondrous tale is written, Full clear, on ev'ry page; Our fathers owned thy goodness, And we their deeds record; And both of this bear witness: One Church, one Faith, one Lord.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Thy heralds brought glad tidings To greatest, as to least; They bade men rise, and hasten To share the great king's feast; And this was all their teaching, In every deed and word, To all alike proclaiming One Church, one Faith, one Lord.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: When shadows thick were falling, And all seemed sunk in night, Thou, Lord, didst send thy servants, Thy chosen sons of light. On them and on thy people Thy plenteous grace was poured, And this was still their message: One Church, one Faith, one Lord.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Through many a day of darkness, Through many a scene of strife, The faithful few fought bravely, To guard the nation's life. Their gospel of redemption, sin pardoned, man restored, Was all in this enfolded: One Church, one faith, one Lord.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: And we, shall we be faithless? Shall hearts fail, hands hang down? Shall we evade the conflict, And cast away our crown? Not so: in God's deep counsels Some better thing is stored; We will maintain, unflinching, One Church, one Faith, one Lord.

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: Thy mercy will not fail us, Nor leave thy work undone; With thy right hand to help us The vict'ry shall be won; And then, by men and angels Thy name shall be adored. And this shall be their anthem: One Church, one Faith, one Lord.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Nos autem gloriari oportet In Cruce Domini nostri Jesu Christi, In quo est salus, vita, Et resurrectio nostra: Per quem salvati, Et liberati sumus. Deus misereatur nostri, Et benedicat nobis: Illuminet vultum suum super nos, Et misereatur nostri.

hymns.title: O REDEMPTOR

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Arbor foeta alma luce Hoc sacrandum protulit, Fert hoc prona praesens turba Salvatori saeculi.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Consecrare tu dignare, Rex perennis patriae, Hoc olívum, sígnum vívum, Iura contra daemonum.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Ut novetur sexus omnis Unctione Chrísmatis: Ut sanetur sauciata Dignitatis gloria.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Lota mente sacro fonte Aufugantur crimina, Uncta fronte sacrosancta Influunt charismata.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Corde natus ex Parentis Alvum implens Virginis, Praesta lucem, claude mortem Chrísmatis consortibus.

hymns.refrain: O Redemptor sume carmen Temet concinentium.

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Vexilla Regis prodeunt: Fulget Crucis mysterium, Qua vita mortem pertulit, Et morte vitam protulit.

verses.label: VERSE 2
verses.text: Quae vulnerata lanceae Mucrone diro, criminum Ut nos lavaret sordibus, Manavit unda et sanguine.

verses.label: VERSE 3
verses.text: Impleta sunt quae concinit David fideli carmine, Dicendo nationibus: Regnavit a ligno Deus.

verses.label: VERSE 4
verses.text: Arbor decora et fulgida, Ornata Regis purpura, Electa digno stipite Tam sancta membra tangere.

verses.label: VERSE 5
verses.text: Beata, cuius brachiis Pretium pependit saeculi: Statera facta corporis, Tulitque praedam tartari.

verses.label: VERSE 6
verses.text: O Crux ave, spes unica, Hoc Passionis tempore Piis adauge gratiam, Reisque dele crimina.

verses.label: VERSE 7
verses.text: Te, fons salutis Trinitas, Collaudet omnis spiritus: Quibus Crucis victoriam Largiris, adde praemium. Amen.

hymns.title: VICTIMAE PASCHALI LAUDES
hymns.attribution: Attr. To Wipo of Burgundy (10th Century)

verses.label: VERSE 1
verses.text: Victimae paschali laudes immolent Christiani. Agnus redemit oves: Christus innocens Patri Reconciliavit peccatores. Mors et vita duello Conflixere mirando: Dux vitae mortuus, Regnat vivus. Dic nobis Maria, Quid vidisti in via? Sepulcrum Christi viventis, Et gloriam vidi resurgentis: Angelicos testes, Sudarium, et vestes. Surrexit Christus spes mea: Praecedet suos [vos] in Galilaeam. Scimus Christum surrexisse A mortuis vere: Tu nobis, victor Rex, miserere. Amen. [Alleluia.]
